hero.title: Your clients book online.
hero.subtitle: A booking website for your salon, clinic, or barbershop. Your clients book appointments or join the queue from their phone. You manage everything from a dashboard.
hero.footnote: Free to start. Ready in 5 minutes. No credit card needed.
howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps. Five minutes. Your clients book online.
howItWorks.step1.title: Create your account
howItWorks.step1.desc: Add your services, your hours, and your team in 5 minutes. You get a public link to share.
howItWorks.step1.detail: Fill in your name, email, and choose a password. Add your services (men's haircut, facial treatment, etc.), set your hours, and invite your team. That's it.
howItWorks.step2.title: Share your link
howItWorks.step2.desc: On WhatsApp, Instagram, or on your storefront. Your clients book without having to call you.
howItWorks.step2.detail: Copy your Leenya link and post it on your social networks, add it to your Instagram bio, or print a QR code for your window. Each click = one booking.
howItWorks.step3.title: Manage in real time
howItWorks.step3.desc: All bookings and the queue appear in your dashboard. Accessible from your phone.
howItWorks.step3.detail: You see who's arriving, who's waiting, who's in progress. One click to call the next client, another to mark as served. Notifications go out automatically.

testimonials.title: Our approach
testimonials.subtitle: Three beliefs that drive everything we build.
testimonials.card1.title: Your time matters
testimonials.card1.desc: Your time and your customers' time — every minute counts. We built Leenya so you spend less on busywork and more on what truly matters: your craft and the people who trust you.
testimonials.card2.title: A modern Algeria
testimonials.card2.desc: We believe in a modern, digital Algeria where every business — from a barbershop in Oran to a clinic in Constantine — has access to tools that work. Simple, powerful, and built for us.
testimonials.card3.title: Grow different
testimonials.card3.desc: Your business is one of a kind. You deserve tools that help you stand out, grow on your own terms, and stay true to what makes you different. That's the future we're building.

faq.title: Questions?
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we're asked most often.
faq.a1: You create an account in 2 minutes, add your services and hours, then share your Leenya link. Your clients book directly from their phone. You manage everything from your dashboard.
faq.q2: Will my clients know how to use this?
faq.a2: Yes. They click a link, choose a service, a date, a time slot. It's like ordering an Uber. No app to download, no account to create.
faq.a3: Absolutely. No commitment. No penalty. You can delete your account whenever you want, with one click.
faq.q4: Does it work for my type of business?
faq.a4: Leenya is designed for hair salons, clinics, barbershops, beauty institutes, medical practices, and any business that manages appointments or a queue.
faq.a5: We respond on WhatsApp, by email, and we're preparing a help center with video tutorials. In Algeria, we speak French, Arabic, and Tamazight.
faq.a6: Yes. The Free plan includes 3 staff members, the Pro plan up to 7, and the Business plan unlimited.
